meta.name: experimentation
meta.description: Designs, runs, and reads A/B tests and growth experiments — hypothesis, sample size, duration, and honest interpretation. Use this to plan a test, judge whether a result is real, build an experimentation program, decide what to test next, or diagnose why tests keep producing inconclusive or non-replicating results.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计可信的增长实验,看懂结果是否真实
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常做 A/B 测试却拿不准结论是否可靠
copy.tagline_en: Design and run A/B tests with trustworthy, honest conclusions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run experiments but doubt whether the results are real.

howto.what: 它会按实验规范指导 A/B 测试：产出带机制假设、一个主指标、样本量、时长、护栏指标的计划；提醒不要中途偷看数据；解读时区分统计显著与实际价值，把“无结论”当作有效结果，并附常用工具和雷区。
howto.when: 当你请它计划一个新测试、判断测试结果是否可信，或诊断测试为何总是没结论时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个产品文案改版的 A/B 测试，第一步该做什么？
say.note: 它会先要你写假设、定主指标并算样本量。

say.text: 实验显示转化率涨了 0.3% 且显著，能直接上线吗？
say.note: 它会让你核对预设时长和护栏指标，判断值不值得发布。

say.text: 我们连续三个实验都不显著，问题出在哪？
say.note: 它会说明无结论也能提供信息，建议换测高杠杆问题。

howto.what_en: Pre-test checks: mechanism-based hypothesis, one primary metric, sample size, duration, guardrails. Warns against peeking; reads only at the scheduled end; treats inconclusive as a real result.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to plan a test, judge whether a result is real, or diagnose why tests keep coming out inconclusive.

say_en.text: Help me design an A/B test for a copy change. What do we do first?
say_en.note: It will ask for a hypothesis, one primary metric, and sample size.

say_en.text: The test shows a 0.3% lift and is significant. Should we ship it?
say_en.note: It will remind you to check planned duration and guardrails first.

say_en.text: Three experiments in a row were inconclusive. What's wrong?
say_en.note: It will treat that as useful information and suggest higher-leverage tests.
